newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy gradually recovering--EPA minister.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy gradually recovering--EPA minister.

text.p: Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Taro Aso told a parliamentary committee on Tuesday that Japan's economy continues to recover gradually.
He told the budget committee of parliament's Lower House that there are some worries about the nation's employment situation.
"However, those people who are quitting jobs voluntarily are also contributing to a high level of unemployment. The Japanese economy continues to recover gradually," he said.
